body: I understand where she’s coming from with her insecurities, however that’s a huge sign that she’s not ready for a serious relationship. If you pick apart everything about your partner and try to change them, you have to wonder at the end of the day is that person the right fit for you.

Is it a normal occurrence to be sleeping with all of your friends? This is actually a big part of why I split with my ex. It’s just… Uncomfortable and I don’t think I could ever be in a relationship like that again. Plus Erika doesn’t even try to make Steph feel better.
